listening.audio_text: During the debate, participants presented contrasting views on whether economic growth should outweigh environmental protection.

question_translation.Hindi: वक्ता क्या वर्णन कर रहा है?
question_translation.Japanese: 話者は何を説明していますか？

listening.question: What concern does the speaker express?
listening.audio_text: The growing reliance on artificial intelligence raises questions about accountability and human oversight.

question_translation.Hindi: वक्ता किस चिंता को व्यक्त करता है?
question_translation.Japanese: 話者はどんな懸念を表していますか？

listening.question: What is the likely purpose of this talk?
listening.audio_text: Today I will examine the historical significance of the Renaissance in shaping modern thought.

question_translation.Hindi: इस वार्ता का संभावित उद्देश्य क्या है?
question_translation.Japanese: この講演の目的は何ですか？

listening.question: What attitude does the speaker show?
listening.audio_text: It is remarkable how intercultural communication can prevent misunderstandings in global cooperation.

question_translation.Hindi: वक्ता कौन सा दृष्टिकोण दिखाता है?
question_translation.Japanese: 話者はどんな態度を示していますか？

listening.question: What is the speaker’s critique?
listening.audio_text: Many academic articles fail to present evidence clearly, which weakens their arguments.

question_translation.Hindi: वक्ता की आलोचना क्या है?
question_translation.Japanese: 話者の批判は何ですか？

listening.question: What is the speaker analyzing?
listening.audio_text: The novel uses irony and symbolism to highlight issues of social inequality.

question_translation.Hindi: वक्ता किसका विश्लेषण कर रहा है?
question_translation.Japanese: 話者は何を分析していますか？

listening.question: What is the speaker proposing?
listening.audio_text: We should design international agreements that ensure fair distribution of vaccines in future pandemics.

question_translation.Hindi: वक्ता क्या प्रस्तावित कर रहा है?
question_translation.Japanese: 話者は何を提案していますか？

listening.question: What rhetorical device is being used?
listening.audio_text: Is it not our responsibility to protect future generations from climate disaster?

question_translation.Hindi: कौन सा अलंकार प्रयोग किया जा रहा है?
question_translation.Japanese: どの修辞技法が使われていますか？

listening.question: What challenge is the speaker describing?
listening.audio_text: Managing large-scale projects often requires balancing limited resources with ambitious goals.

question_translation.Hindi: वक्ता किस चुनौती का वर्णन कर रहा है?
question_translation.Japanese: 話者はどんな課題を説明していますか？

listening.question: What does the speaker suggest about leadership?
listening.audio_text: Effective leaders adapt their management style depending on the needs of the team.

question_translation.Hindi: नेतृत्व के बारे में वक्ता क्या सुझाव देता है?
question_translation.Japanese: リーダーシップについて話者は何を提案していますか？

listening.question: What historical point is the speaker making?
listening.audio_text: The Cold War shaped international relations by creating a division between two powerful blocs.

question_translation.Hindi: वक्ता कौन सा ऐतिहासिक बिंदु प्रस्तुत कर रहा है?
question_translation.Japanese: 話者はどの歴史的な点を述べていますか？

listening.question: What is the speaker questioning?
listening.audio_text: Can we truly claim that economic growth alone guarantees social progress?

question_translation.Hindi: वक्ता किस पर सवाल उठा रहा है?
question_translation.Japanese: 話者は何を疑問視していますか？

listening.question: What is the central theme?
listening.audio_text: Philosophy encourages us to question assumptions and consider multiple perspectives on truth.

question_translation.Hindi: मुख्य विषय क्या है?
question_translation.Japanese: 中心的なテーマは何ですか？

speaking.question: Say: 'The evidence suggests, albeit inconclusively, that the policy has had some positive effects.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'सबूत से पता चलता है, हालांकि निर्णायक नहीं है, कि नीति का कुछ सकारात्मक प्रभाव हुआ है।'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: '証拠は決定的ではないが、その政策にいくらかの良い影響があったことを示しています。'

speaking.answer: the evidence suggests albeit inconclusively that the policy has had some positive effects

speaking.question: Say: 'Rarely have I encountered such a convincing argument in political discourse.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'राजनीतिक विमर्श में मैंने शायद ही कभी इतना विश्वसनीय तर्क देखा है।'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: '政治的な言説でこれほど説得力のある主張に出会ったことはめったにありません。'

speaking.answer: rarely have i encountered such a convincing argument in political discourse

speaking.question: Say: 'Ethical dilemmas often force us to choose between two equally difficult options.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'नैतिक दुविधाएँ अक्सर हमें दो समान रूप से कठिन विकल्पों के बीच चुनने के लिए मजबूर करती हैं।'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: '倫理的ジレンマはしばしば私たちに同じくらい難しい二つの選択肢の間で選ばせます。'

speaking.answer: ethical dilemmas often force us to choose between two equally difficult options

speaking.question: Say: 'One cannot underestimate the historical significance of the Renaissance.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'पुनर्जागरण के ऐतिहासिक महत्व को कम करके नहीं आंका जा सकता।'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'ルネサンスの歴史的意義を過小評価することはできません。'

speaking.answer: one cannot underestimate the historical significance of the renaissance

speaking.question: Say: 'The research highlights the need for greater intercultural communication in global business.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'शोध वैश्विक व्यापार में अधिक अंतरसांस्कृतिक संचार की आवश्यकता को रेखांकित करता है।'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: '研究はグローバルビジネスにおける異文化コミュニケーションの必要性を強調しています。'

speaking.answer: the research highlights the need for greater intercultural communication in global business

speaking.question: Say: 'Had the government acted sooner, the crisis might have been averted.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'अगर सरकार ने पहले कार्रवाई की होती, तो संकट टल सकता था।'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: '政府がもっと早く行動していれば、危機は回避できたかもしれません。'

speaking.answer: had the government acted sooner the crisis might have been averted

speaking.question: Say: 'Philosophy encourages us to question assumptions and broaden perspectives.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'दर्शन हमें मान्यताओं पर प्रश्नचिह्न लगाने और दृष्टिकोण को व्यापक बनाने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करता है।'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: '哲学は私たちに前提を問い、視点を広げることを促します。'

speaking.answer: philosophy encourages us to question assumptions and broaden perspectives

speaking.question: Say: 'The irony of the situation was lost on most of the audience.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'स्थिति की विडंबना दर्शकों के अधिकांश हिस्से को समझ में नहीं आई।'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'その状況の皮肉は観客の大部分に理解されませんでした。'

speaking.answer: the irony of the situation was lost on most of the audience

speaking.question: Say: 'It is imperative that scientific claims be evaluated with skepticism and rigor.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'यह आवश्यक है कि वैज्ञानिक दावों का संदेह और कठोरता के साथ मूल्यांकन किया जाए।'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: '科学的な主張は懐疑と厳密さをもって評価されることが不可欠です。'

speaking.answer: it is imperative that scientific claims be evaluated with skepticism and rigor

speaking.question: Say: 'Seldom has society faced such complex global health challenges.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'समाज ने शायद ही कभी इतने जटिल वैश्विक स्वास्थ्य चुनौतियों का सामना किया है।'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: '社会がこれほど複雑な世界的健康課題に直面したことはめったにありません。'

speaking.answer: seldom has society faced such complex global health challenges

speaking.question: Say: 'In my view, economic policy must balance growth with social equity.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'मेरे विचार में, आर्थिक नीति को विकास और सामाजिक समानता के बीच संतुलन बनाना चाहिए।'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: '私の考えでは、経済政策は成長と社会的公平を両立させる必要があります。'

speaking.answer: in my view economic policy must balance growth with social equity

speaking.question: Say: 'The editorial offered a sharp critique of media practices.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'संपादकीय ने मीडिया प्रथाओं की तीखी आलोचना की।'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: '社説はメディアの慣行を鋭く批判しました。'

speaking.answer: the editorial offered a sharp critique of media practices

speaking.question: Say: 'Not until much later did the significance of the discovery become clear.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'काफी बाद तक खोज का महत्व स्पष्ट नहीं हुआ।'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'ずっと後になって初めて発見の重要性が明らかになりました。'

speaking.answer: not until much later did the significance of the discovery become clear

speaking.question: Say: 'Effective negotiation requires empathy as well as strategic thinking.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'प्रभावी वार्ता के लिए सहानुभूति और रणनीतिक सोच दोनों की आवश्यकता होती है।'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: '効果的な交渉には、共感と戦略的思考の両方が必要です。'

speaking.answer: effective negotiation requires empathy as well as strategic thinking

speaking.question: Say: 'The data visualization illustrates trends in urbanization over the past fifty years.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'डेटा विज़ुअलाइज़ेशन पिछले पचास वर्षों में शहरीकरण की प्रवृत्तियों को दर्शाता है।'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'データの可視化は過去50年間の都市化の傾向を示しています。'

speaking.answer: the data visualization illustrates trends in urbanization over the past fifty years

speaking.question: Say: 'Globalization has blurred cultural boundaries while also creating new identities.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'वैश्वीकरण ने सांस्कृतिक सीमाओं को धुंधला कर दिया है और नई पहचानें भी बनाई हैं।'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'グローバリゼーションは文化的境界を曖昧にし、新しいアイデンティティを生み出しました。'

speaking.answer: globalization has blurred cultural boundaries while also creating new identities

speaking.question: Say: 'The proposal was rejected, not because it lacked merit, but because of financial limitations.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'प्रस्ताव को अस्वीकार किया गया, क्योंकि उसमें योग्यता की कमी नहीं थी, बल्कि वित्तीय सीमाओं के कारण।'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'その提案は価値がなかったからではなく、財政的な制約のために却下されました。'

speaking.answer: the proposal was rejected not because it lacked merit but because of financial limitations

speaking.question: Say: 'The documentary shed light on complex social problems rarely discussed in mainstream media.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'डॉक्यूमेंट्री ने जटिल सामाजिक समस्याओं पर प्रकाश डाला जिन पर मुख्यधारा मीडिया में शायद ही चर्चा होती है।'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'そのドキュメンタリーは主流メディアでめったに議論されない複雑な社会問題に光を当てました。'

speaking.answer: the documentary shed light on complex social problems rarely discussed in mainstream media

speaking.question: Say: 'Were I to lead the project, I would implement a more inclusive strategy.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'अगर मैं परियोजना का नेतृत्व करता, तो मैं एक अधिक समावेशी रणनीति लागू करता।'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: 'もし私がプロジェクトを率いるなら、より包括的な戦略を実行します。'

speaking.answer: were i to lead the project i would implement a more inclusive strategy

speaking.question: Say: 'It is essential to critique arguments, not just accept them at face value.'

question_translation.Hindi: कहें: 'यह आवश्यक है कि तर्कों की आलोचना की जाए, न कि उन्हें सतही रूप से स्वीकार किया जाए।'
question_translation.Japanese: 言ってください: '議論を表面的に受け入れるのではなく、批判することが不可欠です。'

speaking.answer: it is essential to critique arguments not just accept them at face value
